messages:
maria-sales: Hey team — ZenBridge is ready to start a 2-week POC but legal asked for SOC 2 artifacts + an ISO cert copy and a signed pen-test letter before they spin up staging. Can we confirm what we can provide this week?

josh-se: I can pull SOC2 summary + scope and the SOC2 report extract we share for POCs. Need to confirm redaction rules though.

rebecca-security: We can provide the SOC2 Type II summary and control matrix (redacted). For full report they want, we require an NDA and a secure transfer. For ISO, we can share the cert PDF.

sam-ps: ZenBridge is asking for the pen-test letter with a signatory name so their vendor can validate. Do we have a standard pen-test attestation template we can send?

rebecca-security: Yes — we have a pen-test attestation template. It states: "Redwood Inference confirms a third-party penetration test was completed on YYYY-MM and no critical open findings at time of test." Legal prefers not to share raw pentest results; we can offer an attestation + signed letter.

audits-bot: action: create presigned S3 for certificate delivery (expires 7d) — created by devex — link hidden for thread.

maria-sales: ZenBridge also flagged data residency — they need eu-west-1 only for the POC. We promised demo in their region; is that covered under our Private / Dedicated options? Pricing will be a blocker.

josh-se: For a short POC we can run them on Hosted in eu-west-1 with a dedicated VPC bridge (private option) — it affects pricing. I'll draft a cost delta: ~1.6x for reserved capacity for 2 weeks.

sam-ps: If Legal needs the pen-test letter signed by someone, rebecca — can you sign or point who signs on security side? They prefer a CISO-level signatory.

rebecca-security: I can sign as Director of Security. If they want CISO title, legal might ask for exec approval — could slow things. Offer Director + contact email.

maria-sales: Anything else they typically ask? They mentioned KMS separation and audit access windows.

josh-se: For KMS, we can provide: staging keys are customer-sequestered in Dedicated/Private. For Hosted demo we can offer ephemeral keys & show key management diagram. If they need KMS split for POC we need 72h ops lead time.

rebecca-security: Audit access: we can provide a read-only evidence bundle and schedule a 2-hour walkthrough with our security engineer. For live auditor access to systems we need a signed statement and SSO accounts — 5 business days to provision.

maria-sales: Ok next steps: 1) rebecca share pen-test attestation + signatory (TODAY) 2) devex upload ISO cert + SOC2 summary to presigned link (TODAY) 3) josh SD to send eu-west pricing delta and ksm lead time (TOMORROW) 4) schedule 2hr audit walkthrough if they want it (sam will own).

rebecca-security: Will attach signed attestation to presigned link and add contact details.

devex: Presigned link created and DM'd to Maria. Reminder: do not paste links in public channels. :lock:

sam-ps: Scheduling hold for audit walkthrough — I'll propose Wed 10am UTC.

maria-sales: Thanks all. I'll let ZenBridge know we can provide attestation + certs today and clarify data residency pricing tomorrow. :thumbsup:
